title: Study of FYU-981 in Hyperuricemic Outpatients With or Without Gout (Effect on Two Hyperuricemic Types)
brief_summary: To investigate the pharmacodynamics and safety of FYU-981 administered orally once a day for 14 weeks, to uric acid-overproduction type or uric acid-underexcretion type of male hyperuricemic outpatients with or without gout.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Serum urate level:

  * \>= 7.0mg/dL in patients with gouty nodule or with history of gout, or \>=8.0mg/dL in patients with hypertension, diabetes or metabolic syndrome, or \>= 9.0mg/dL
* Disease type in the classification of hyperuricemia: Uric acid-overproduction type or Uric acid-underexcretion type
* Outpatients

Exclusion Criteria:

* Gouty arthritis within 14 days before randomized allocation
